name: Call of Water
summary: Across the sea, Call of Water carries Barrens shamans to Silverpine Forest. There, an initiate faces the blight on an ancient coastal shrine to earn communion with water spirits.

sections.title: A Pilgrimage Across the Sea
sections.body: After gathering drops of pure water with help from the hermit Brine, you return to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast. She sends you across the sea with the purified essence to Silverpine Forest's haunted shore, just west of the Forsaken refuge called the Sepulcher.

sections.title: Cleansing the Everfount
sections.body: The Brazier of Everfount is an ancient focus for the elements, but Lordaeron's plague has twisted its waters. The spirits there have fallen silent and turned feral. Defeat the corrupted manifestation bound to the brazier, then offer its bracers and the purest water to the flame. The blight breaks, and an untainted spirit of the tides appears, ready to grant its blessing.

faq.q: Why does a shaman have to travel all the way to Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Islen Waterseer sends you to face corruption, not merely study peace. The coastal shrine west of the Sepulcher has been tainted by Lordaeron's plague. Healing it may awaken the water spirits, who refuse to speak to anyone else.

faq.q: What happens when you use the Brazier of Everfount?
faq.answer: Place the defeated elemental's bracers and the remaining purest water on the flame. Islen taught this cleansing ritual, which purges the pool and summons a pure spirit of water willing to grant its blessing.

faq.q: Who is corrupting the water shrine in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Lordaeron's lingering plague has twisted the shrine's water. Corruption seeps down from the hills, tainting the spring and turning its native water spirits feral and hostile.

faq.q: What do you receive after completing this trial?
faq.answer: Cleansing the Brazier of Everfount lets you commune with a pure spirit of water, willing to grant its blessing. Bring proof of the cleansing to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens to earn your Water Totem and finish the long trial.

faq.q: Where exactly is the shrine located?
faq.answer: The shrine stands on Silverpine Forest's western coast, over the blighted ridge just west of the Sepulcher.

Islen Waterseer is a tauren shaman who lives along the Merchant Coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. A revered spiritual guide, she instructs young Horde shamans in the difficult rites that attune them to water.

angles.text: As a shaman, you learn that your calling reaches beyond storms: you can heal broken lands and purge spiritual blight.
As an orc or tauren, you travel from Kalimdor into Silverpine Forest and witness firsthand the grim, plague-ridden hardships your Forsaken allies face.
